timeline.summary: FAL Corporation, as Go Digit General Insurance Limited’s promoter, declared no new encumbrances on shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Go Digit General Insurance received no adverse observation letters from NSE and BSE for its proposed amalgamation with Go Digit Infoworks Services Private Limited.
Go Digit General Insurance Limited, via **Tejas Saraf**, revised the Q4 & FY2026 earnings call from 6:30 PM IST to 6:00 PM IST on **28 April 2026**.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹2,301.02 Cr (+2.4% YoY), net profit ₹149.42 Cr (+29.2% YoY).
Go Digit General Insurance reported Q4FY26 IndAS PBT of ₹239 Cr up 68.3% YoY, with AUM reaching ₹22,922 Cr.
Go Digit General Insurance Limited hosted earnings call audio recording for Q4-FY2025-26 on **28th April 2026**, available at godigit.com.
Go Digit General Insurance published its 14th Transparency Report for FY2025-26 detailing service and claims turnaround times.
Go Digit General Insurance hosted its Q4 & FY2026 earnings conference call on April 28, 2026.
Go Digit General Insurance received a GST show cause notice demanding ₹20.51 Cr for ineligible input tax credit covering September 2022 to March 2024.
Q1FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹2,006.96 Cr (+7.6% YoY), net profit ₹86.39 Cr (-37.5% YoY).
Go Digit General Insurance Limited hosted the earnings call audio recording for Q1 FY2026-27 on its website on 23rd July 2026, signed by **Tejas Saraf**
Go Digit General Insurance rescheduled its 10th AGM to August 18, 2026 and re-circulated its FY2025-26 annual report.
2026-07-29: NSE sought clarification on Go Digit Infoworks merger news
2026-07-29: CCI approved the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation with Go Digit Infoworks Services Private Limited
Go Digit General Insurance hosted its Q1FY27 earnings conference call on July 23, 2026, highlighting a deliberate focus on profitability over growth.
Go Digit General Insurance announced receipt of NCLT first motion order for the scheme of amalgamation with Go Digit Infoworks Services.
Go Digit General Insurance Limited’s 10th AGM on August 18, 2026, approved all resolutions with full member support via remote e-voting and physical attendance.
2026-09-01: Go Digit General Insurance received the detailed CCI order approving the scheme of amalgamation with Go Digit Infoworks Services.
Go Digit General Insurance updated its proposed scheme of amalgamation with Go Digit Infoworks Services to incorporate Section 35 of the Insurance Act as advised by IRDAI.
CRISIL Ratings reaffirmed Go Digit General Insurance's Corporate Credit Rating at AA- with Rating Watch with Developing Implications on September 23, 2026.
Go Digit issued notice convening NCLT-directed shareholder meeting on November 5, 2026, to approve amalgamation with Go Digit Infoworks.
Fairfax Financial was declared strategic buyer for a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank and announced plans to contribute Digit Insurance to the bank.
CRISIL reaffirmed Go Digit's Corporate Credit Rating at AA- and revised the watch to Positive Implications from Developing Implications.
